<article class="doc wide"><h1>Upgrades: stronger in every run</h1><p class="lead"><b>Upgrades</b> are bought with Pokécoins from the menu and they're <b>per Pokémon</b>: each one has its own. Every level costs more than the last. They don't count in the weekly challenge (the Pokémon is on loan); in a group, everyone brings their own.</p><div class="tablewrap"><table class="list"><thead><tr><th>Upgrade</th><th>Each level</th><th>Max</th><th>Price per level</th><th>Total</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/heart.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Vitality</b></td><td>+3 HP</td><td>10</td><td>60 → 890</td><td>3,270</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/fist.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Strength</b></td><td>+1.5% damage</td><td>10</td><td>80 → 1,450</td><td>5,050</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/boot.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Stride</b></td><td>+1.5% speed</td><td>8</td><td>70 → 740</td><td>2,420</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/clock.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Reflexes</b></td><td>-1% recarga</td><td>8</td><td>90 → 1,050</td><td>3,340</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/shield.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Armor</b></td><td>+0.75% defense</td><td>8</td><td>80 → 840</td><td>2,750</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/sprout.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Synthesis</b></td><td>+0.1 HP/s</td><td>5</td><td>120 → 610</td><td>1,590</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/magnet.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Magnet</b></td><td>+12% pickup</td><td>6</td><td>50 → 270</td><td>820</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/book.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Wisdom</b></td><td>+2% experience</td><td>8</td><td>100 → 1,160</td><td>3,700</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/coin.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Fortune</b></td><td>+8% PokéCoins</td><td>8</td><td>120 → 1,620</td><td>4,950</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/cards.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Repertoire</b></td><td>Start with 2 moves</td><td>1</td><td>1,500</td><td>1,500</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/star.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Critical Hit</b></td><td>+1% critical hits (×1.5 damage)</td><td>10</td><td>90 → 1,860</td><td>6,300</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/star.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Power Crits</b></td><td>+5% critical damage</td><td>10</td><td>90 → 1,860</td><td>6,300</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/up.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Card reroll</b></td><td>+1 level-up card reroll per run</td><td>5</td><td>150 → 980</td><td>2,360</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/ban.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Ban</b></td><td>Ban 1 move: it never shows up in your cards</td><td>5</td><td>300 → 3,910</td><td>7,920</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/cursor.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Starting move</b></td><td>Choose which move you start the run with</td><td>1</td><td>400</td><td>400</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/cursor.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Second starting move</b></td><td>Choose the second move you start with (needs Repertoire)</td><td>1</td><td>400</td><td>400</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/bag.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Second item</b></td><td>You can hold 2 items at once in a run</td><td>1</td><td>10,000</td><td>10,000</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/bag.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Third item</b></td><td>Legendary upgrade: carry 3 items at once</td><td>1</td><td>30,000</td><td>30,000</td></tr><tr><td><img src="../../assets/pages/icons/cursor.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24"> <b>Starting item</b></td><td>You start with the item you choose (one is used up)</td><td>1</td><td>400</td><td>400</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p>Maxing everything costs <b>93,470 Pokécoins</b> per Pokémon. With all of them, a Pokémon hits and endures about 1.3 times more: they help, but playing well matters most.</p><div class="tip"><b>Tip:</b> <b>Repertoire</b> (start with 2 moves) and <b>Veto</b> (moves you don't want stop showing up) change runs a lot. <b>Second</b> and <b>Third item</b> are pricey, but holding three items at once is very strong. And if you already hold three, the rare <b>fourth item</b> card can show up during a run.</div><p class="cta"><a class="btn" href="../../en/">Play free</a></p></article>
